_note: Fill model ids and prices from the official docs/pricing pages on the day you run. Keys come from the env variables named here. Model keys ('48', '55', ...) must match the 'model' column of plan.csv. Optional 'verifier' on a model = another model key used for independent cross-source checks (Track B realises source='model:B'). The verifier must NOT be one of the models compared in the plan (e.g. never '55' for '48': the weak arm would get the strong arm's answers); the runner refuses that. Use a third model that is not stronger than the weak arm, e.g. 'os1', or leave it null.
